name: Snowflake Cortex
short: Managed LLM inference and AI toolset embedded in the Snowflake data platform, serving 50+ models from 14 providers (Anthropic, OpenAI, Meta, DeepSeek, Google, Mistral, xAI, Alibaba/Qwen, Moonshot, Z.ai/GLM, NVIDIA, Microsoft, Voyage, Snowflake Arctic) via SQL AI Functions, REST API, Agents, Search and Code — billed in AI Credits ($2.00–$2.20 each) per million tokens.

plans.name: AI Credits (pay-as-you-go)
plans.notes: Per-model token rates in AI Credits per 1M; frontier models cost significantly more than open-weight (59x spread observed at Summit 2026). Prompt-cache reads at a reduced rate. ACV-based volume discounts apply automatically. No per-seat fee. Model rates in Table 6 of the Snowflake Service Consumption Table.

plans.name: Platform requirement
plans.price: Requires a Snowflake subscription (no standalone LLM signup)
plans.notes: AI features are available to Snowflake accounts on any edition (Standard–VPS). 30-day platform trial available. Cortex Fine-tuning and Cortex Analyst (legacy API) bill in Platform Credits rather than AI Credits.
